Screening location: SIFF Cinema Uptown – 511 Queen Anne Ave N, Seattle

PULP: WHAT DO YOU DO FOR AN ENCORE? captures PULP during their 2025 tour, combining footage from their ingenious live show with four decades of never-before-seen archival material. Directed by longtime collaborator Garth Jennings and narrated by frontman Jarvis Cocker, the film traces the band’s circuitous journey from Sheffield outsiders to unlikely cultural icons.

“What makes PULP: What Do You Do for an Encore? so engaging is the mix of live material and archival footage that explores the drive to keep performing beyond financial benefit. Songs are a connective tissue to the past for the band and fans alike; the documentary and concert double as a time machine that will leave a huge smile on any Pulp fan’s face.” Emma Fraser, Little White Lies
